51:t_1:93.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Creatures that inhabit the $$残されの海$$. To us, they are sacred beings that must not be harmed.」

51:t_1:94.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「If you encounter any $$クジライカ$$, I ask that you leave them alone.」

51:t_1:96.en:
$$テッサ$$
(So it is a kind of indigenous faith...)

51:t_1:97.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I have entrusted all arrangements for repairing your ships to $$リジット$$ here.」

51:t_1:98.en:
$$リジット$$
「I look forward to working with you.」

51:t_1:99.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Likewise. We appreciate your help, Ms. $$リジット$$.」

51:t_1:100.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Our fleet's technology may be of little use, but we can at least provide materials.」

51:t_1:101.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「If you pay a fair price, we will supply other provisions as far as we are able.」

51:t_1:103.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Please think nothing of it. Wherever you came from, you are fellow people whom we have met on this sea.」

51:t_1:104.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「We have a saying: 'Give fresh water to those who bring you fish'...」

51:t_1:105.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Helping you simply follows that saying. As people living in the same world, let us help each other as much as we can.」

51:t_1:106.en:
$$リジット$$
「Yes, this is $$リジット$$.」

51:t_1:108.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「What is it, $$リジット$$?」

51:t_1:109.en:
$$リジット$$
「Apparently, a person has emerged from the machine $$ベローズ$$ salvaged.」

51:t_1:114.en:
$$アルト$$
「...So you guys have only been with this fleet for three months too, $$ガロード$$?」

51:t_1:115.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah. That's why we don't really know what's happening in the other regions.」

51:t_1:116.en:
$$パーラ$$
「It's comfortable here. The food's good, too. ...Right, $$ティファ$$?」

51:t_1:118.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「As long as $$ティファ$$'s with you, $$ガロード$$, you could live anywhere.」

51:t_1:120.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「But it really does have a nice atmosphere here. All the girls are so carefree.」

51:t_1:121.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's what it always comes down to with you.」

51:t_1:122.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$ティファ$$, now that you're used to life here, why not be a little more open yourself?」

51:t_1:124.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't leer at $$ティファ$$.」

51:t_1:125.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I was kidding, kidding! Don't get so mad, $$ガロード$$.」

51:t_1:126.en:
$$マオ$$
「You really do this anywhere, don't you?」

51:t_1:127.en:
$$宗介$$
「You mean he has excellent terrain adaptability?」

51:t_1:128.en:
$$かなめ$$
「This one's his usual self, too.」

51:t_1:129.en:
$$宗介$$
「Not entirely. I'm off duty today, so I'm trying to enjoy this fleet in my own way.」

51:t_1:130.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I never thought I'd hear $$宗介$$ say the word 'enjoy'...」

51:t_1:131.en:
$n
「What are you planning? Target practice? Martial arts?」

51:t_1:133.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$千鳥$$, would you like to go out with me?」

51:t_1:136.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Um... What are you saying, all of a sudden...?」

51:t_1:137.en:
$$宗介$$
「It shouldn't be all of a sudden.」

51:t_1:139.en:
$$スズネ$$
($$千鳥$$... I think $$宗介$$ only meant to invite you along for his idea of fun...)

51:t_1:140.en:
$n
(It's fine, Miss $$スズネ$$. Let's enjoy seeing how this plays out.)

51:t_1:141.en:
$$アルト$$
(This is an unexpected turn in an unexpected place...)

51:t_1:143.en:
$$ガロード$$
(They're really rubbing it in, in this heat.)

51:t_1:144.en:
$$パーラ$$
(That's what I always swallow without saying it.)

51:t_1:146.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...You're saying this in a place like this?」

51:t_1:147.en:
$$宗介$$
「Precisely because we're in a place like this.」

51:t_1:148.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well... We're in an unfamiliar situation, and we don't know what tomorrow holds, but...」

51:t_1:149.en:
$$かなめ$$
「B-but... With $$テッサ$$ working so hard, I can't be the only one...」

51:t_1:150.en:
$$宗介$$
「I see. Then I will invite the Captain too.」

51:t_1:152.en:
$$宗介$$
「By my assessment, they'll be biting nonstop. We should reel in plenty.」

51:t_1:153.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-you... Since when did you become such a pickup artist?!」

51:t_1:156.en:
$n
「W-wait, $$千鳥$$! This time, you've got it wrong!」

51:t_1:157.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Th-that's right! $$宗介$$ was only inviting you to go fishing!」

51:t_1:159.en:
$n
「Don't you remember? $$宗介$$ told us fishing was his hobby...」

51:t_1:160.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Come to think of it, he did say something like that when he transferred to our school.」

51:t_1:162.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry, sorry. With the sea all around us, it was such a perfect setting... And that promise we made before, I just...」

51:t_1:164.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'd love to hear all about it.」

51:t_1:167.en:
$n
「I'm fishing at another spot with $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$. How about we compare big catches later?」

51:t_1:169.en:
$n
「The loser takes one turn cooking for the winner... Are you in?」

51:t_1:171.en:
$n
「...Just so we're clear, 'big catches' means fish. $$千鳥$$ doesn't count.」

51:t_1:172.en:
$$かなめ$$
「W-what are you saying?! You too, $n...?」

51:t_1:173.en:
$$メルティ$$
「$$ガロード$$! $$ティファ$$! $$パーラ$$!」

51:t_1:174.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Are these the people who came from the stars?」
